note: For conjugation of G on itself, stabilizer of x is C_G(x), so the conjugacy class has size [G:C_G(x)], a divisor of p^n. It is a singleton iff x is central; hence every noncentral class has size divisible by p. The class equation modulo p gives p divides |Z(G)|, and then |Z(G)| >= p >= 2 gives a nonidentity central element.
